description: D.R. Horton, Inc. is the largest homebuilding company in the United States as measured by number of homes closed, and it constructs and sells homes through its operating divisions in 126 markets across 36 states. Its common stock is included in the S&P 500 Index and listed on the New York Stock Exchange and NYSE Texas under the ticker symbol DHI, with its listing on NYSE Texas becoming effective in June 2025. Its homebuilding business began in 1978 in Fort Worth, Texas, and its common stock has been publicly traded since 1992, and it has expanded and diversified its homebuilding operations geographically over the years by investing capital and building teams of people in its existing markets, starting new operations in additional markets and acquiring other homebuilding companies, having closed more than 1.2 million homes during its 47-year history.
